list.name: Rex
list.ins: Rex, from before the landing to year 1 day 69, died of thirst. First hunter; First herder.

entries.text: Rex made the first leaf bed.
Zean worked a hide until it stayed soft. They watched it happen.
The Hide age begins.
Rex brought down the first hopper: fresh meat.
The village can now raise a hide teepee (hide stretched on poles): the design is in the Blueprints panel.
Lair saw a seed come up where food had rotted, and understood. They watched it happen.
Rex saw that a hopper will stay where it is fed, and understood. They worked it out with their own hands.
Food is running short: about 1.9 days left in the stockpile.
Chob built the first drying rack.
Bral was born to Chob and Zean.
The old thornback died in its cave.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
Chool was born to Bal and Ket.
Cheak was born to Ne and Rex.
Lightning struck a tree 13 cells from the camp. It is burning.
Chob was first to keep a fire. They watched it happen.
The Hearth age dawns, behind the Hide age.
Chob built the first fire ring.
Chob lit the first hearth fire.
Chob was first to burn wood to black coal. They watched it happen.
The burning tree has fallen in on itself and smoulders.
The old thornback died in its cave.
A new thornback has moved into the cave.
Rex (generation 1) died of thirst, aged 3.4 years - 8 beds for 10.
Ne and Cheak and 1 other mourn Rex.
The last person who knew animal keeping has died: Rex. It will have to be found again.
Bal rediscovered animal keeping. They worked it out with their own hands.
Di was born to Chob and Zean.
The old thornback died in its cave.
